title: ROWID chunking selects DBA_EXTENTS.data_object_id — column does not exist
expected_feedback: Critical: this script cannot run. DBA_EXTENTS has no DATA_OBJECT_ID column — its columns are OWNER, SEGMENT_NAME, PARTITION_NAME, SEGMENT_TYPE, TABLESPACE_NAME, EXTENT_ID, FILE_ID, BLOCK_ID, BYTES, BLOCKS and RELATIVE_FNO — so the cursor fails at parse time with ORA-00904: invalid identifier. DATA_OBJECT_ID must come from DBA_OBJECTS, joined per partition because each partition carries its own value. Prefer DBMS_PARALLEL_EXECUTE.CREATE_CHUNKS_BY_ROWID (11.2+), which computes the chunks correctly for partitioned and non-partitioned tables and persists chunk state so an interrupted run resumes instead of restarting. Two further blockers: reading DBA_EXTENTS/DBA_OBJECTS needs DBA-level select privileges the migration account often lacks, and DBMS_LOCK.SLEEP requires an explicit GRANT EXECUTE ON DBMS_LOCK — use DBMS_SESSION.SLEEP (18c+) instead.
violated_rule: Migration scripts must be executable as written
